page_title: FIO 0-0 PAR | Fiorentina v Parma 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+3' Mandela Keita (Parma) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the bottom left corner. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for David de Gea and his brilliant save.
90+2' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lautaro Valenti (Parma) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Hernani (Parma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gianluca Manganiello signals.
86' Fiorentina are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
82' Substitution. Dennis Man (Parma) replaces Ange-Yoan Bonny.
82' Christian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Mateo Pellegrino will be replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
79' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Michael Folorunsho cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Substitution. Albert Gudmundsson walks off the pitch and Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
76' Here comes the VAR decision. NO GOAL!
74' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Gianluca Manganiello immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
73' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but David de Gea comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' The linesman signals a throw-in for Parma.
71' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolo Fagioli as he is replaced by Yacine Adli (Fiorentina).
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Rolando Mandragora walks off the pitch to be replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
69' Dodo (Fiorentina) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Zion Suzuki anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
68' Christian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) replacing Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
66' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
65' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Zion Suzuki punches the ball away.
64' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:5.
62' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
61' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
60' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Moise Kean (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
58' Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.

58' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) sends a direct shot in from a dangerously positioned free kick. The ball sails to the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a quick save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.
57' Christian Chivu prepares a substitution. Giovanni Leoni is replaced by Botond Balogh (Parma).
57' Substitution. Simon Sohm makes way for Hernani (Parma).
56' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
54' Golden chance! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
53' Parma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
51' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but David de Gea comes off the line to clear the ball away.
47' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.
45' A cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dodo (Fiorentina) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
43' Simon Sohm (Parma) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
41' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
39' The foul by Emanuele Valeri (Parma) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
37' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
35' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
34' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
32' Dodo (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
30' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
29' Zion Suzuki is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Pablo Mari (Fiorentina). Easy save!
28' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
26' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
23' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
22' An attempted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is cleared.
20' One of the players from Fiorentina times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' A lofted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
18' Parma are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
16' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
15' Dodo (Fiorentina) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
14' The Fiorentina players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!

11' David de Gea makes a good save! Mandela Keita (Parma) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards on the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
10' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Parma are taking a throw-in.
9' Parma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
8' Dodo (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
6' Dangerous play by Mandela Keita (Parma). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina earn a free kick.
5' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) attempts to find Moise Kean with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.

3' What a save from David de Gea! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
1' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

1' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello was nominated as the referee for this game.
